verdict.rationale: cubic's interactive-comments docs say you can tag @cubic-dev-ai or reply to its existing review comments to continue the conversation, ask questions, trigger reviews and fix issues. The quickstart separately documents replying to a review comment for clarification, plus commands such as `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR` and fixes pushed to the branch. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-thread conversational answers, and detail on what context (diff vs. wider codebase) those replies draw on.
